Среднее изменение цены актива по периода: The average price change of an asset by period of the year. The indicator shows how a given security or index typically behaves in particular hours, weekdays, days of the month and months — averaged over the entire available history.
Это не прогноз, а описание прошлого: в к: This is not a forecast but a description of the past: in which periods the asset tended to rise on average and in which it tended to fall. Past behaviour guarantees nothing about the future.
Данные — с Московской биржи. Чем длиннее: Data comes from the Moscow Exchange. The longer an asset's history, the more robust its seasonal pattern; very young tickers have no established pattern yet.
